headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.70
summary: Client APKs with a built-in mod menu (Sigma/Apollon-style ImGui clients) now show their menu when run through the launcher: the client's extra native library and its overlay view are loaded from the imported APK.

items.text: Mod menus of imported client APKs (GLES3JNIView-style ImGui overlays) now load inside the launcher.
